# Instructor Assignment

## Summary
One Employee's role on one cohort (lead / assistant / grader / guest) with optional module codes. Lives on Cohort.instructors.

## Usage
`@field instructors = containsMany(InstructorAssignmentField);`

## Non-goals
Not a permission model; the role is descriptive.

## Example
The linked cohort carries a lead and an assistant.
attributes.cardDescription: One employee's role on a cohort, lead, assistant, grader or guest, optionally limited to some modules.
